title: NeuroPath: Neurobiology-Inspired Path Tracking and Reflection for Semantically Coherent Retrieval
authors: Junchen Li; Rongzheng Wang; Yihong Huang; Qizhi Chen; Jiasheng Zhang; Shuang Liang
why_relevant: Proposes a graph-based RAG method aimed at reducing irrelevant noise in subgraph retrieval for multi-hop QA, tangentially touching noisy retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving multi-hop retrieval accuracy via semantic paths, not on robustness under unreliable evidence, conflict, adversaries, or calibration.
